ns2:course.label: Real Estate Finance Academy
ns2:course.description: The Real Estate Academy prepares students for careers within the real estate industry. Topics include real estate financial modeling, investment case studies, underwriting real estate markets, and developing professional communication skills. Students who choose to repeat the course assume leadership roles over time. May be repeated for a maximum of 6 hours in separate terms. Prerequisite: Admission by application only. Concurrent enrollment or completion of FIN 241 required.
